      HISTORICAL CONTEXT / ORIGINAL ILLUSTRATIONS

      What this workflow can show

      • Historical Utah-family geometry (Jones, Campbell and Normann, 1992) contextualizes the square, array count and projection. The exact dimensions of the modeled lower layer and the finite tip remain authored assumptions.
      • Historical geometric figures provide context, but this app is not an implementation of that invention or its processes.

      Predecessor workflows and published site files are unchanged. This new private app passes typed data between sealed simulation engines.
